guide.rift.title: ◆ RIFT — a pocket catastrophe
guide.rift.controls: RMB — cast; V or Sneak + RMB — cycle mode. Works in either hand.
guide.rift.vector: VECTOR · 20 energy · up to 6 enemies in a 14-block cone. Hold RMB, release to launch. Auto-release after 3 s; launch deals 18 damage, impact creates a 12-damage wave.
guide.rift.surge: SURGE · 30 energy · dash where you look. Path hits and the final wave deal 22 damage per target. Cannot cross walls; fall protection lasts until landing, at most 6 s.
guide.rift.singularity: SINGULARITY · 80 energy · up to 24 blocks away, 9-block radius. Pulls enemies and items for 3.5 s, then collapses for 40 damage. 12 s cooldown.
guide.rift.safety: 100 energy; +10/s after a 1.5 s pause. No PvP or block destruction. Pets, villagers, golems, named mobs and bosses are protected. Energy persists across logout. Server settings may change damage and regeneration.
guide.rift.recipe: Craft: [echo · amethyst · echo] / [diamond · netherite · diamond] / [crying obsidian · ender pearl · crying obsidian]. Collect an echo shard to unlock the recipe book entry.
